# Spin-offs and demergers — NiftyTotalMarket

*Run 2026-11-16 · filings window 2024-04-01 → 2026-11-15 · 9944 restructuring filings across 682 companies · 39 confirmed demergers, 141 probable, 18 indicated, 825 rights / preferential offerings, 1159 other restructurings · judge: claude-opus-5 read the schemes, three years of calls and the segment pages.*

**The method, in one paragraph.** Spin-offs are where the notes say the bargains hide: the new stock is sold by holders who never chose it for about a year, the parent is often the better buy before the split, insiders tell you what they think through the stock and options they take in the new entity, and a pro-forma statement plus the peer P/E prices what the market is ignoring. This report puts the CONFIRMED demergers first — a demerger scheme on the exchange record — each with when the new entity lists, why management is doing it (three years of calls, with the transcript each point came from), the parent's last three years with charts, P/E and cash flows, and the separated business's own numbers from the annual reports and presentations, page-cited. Probable and indicated cases follow, then every other restructuring on file.

# Confirmed demergers — in full

## ABFRL — Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd.

**CONFIRMED** (a demerger scheme is on the exchange record) · **LISTED 1–2Y — the second-year window** · score 7.1/10 · spin-off · 47 filing(s) from NSE, NSE-register · first 2024-04-01, latest 2026-07-10

> **Listing:** LISTED — Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited trades since about 2025-05-22 (record date 2025-05-22)

**The stages, as filed:** announced (2024-04-19) → exchange_noc (2024-10-30) → meetings (2025-01-21) → nclt_sanction (2024-04-30) → effective (2025-02-14) → record_date (2025-05-22)

**Stated in the filings:** resulting company **Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited**; entitlement **11 for every 6**; record date 2025-05-22; size hint: 8% of revenue.

**What is being separated, as the documents put it:** Madura Fashion & Lifestyle business — lifestyle apparel brands — transferred to Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited on a going-concern basis — class `value_unlocking`.

- *Insiders:* 1:1 issue mirrors ABFRL holdings, so promoters replicate their stake; ABLBL board includes Ananyashree Birla, Aryaman Vikram Birla; Ashish Dikshit MD, Vishak Kumar Deputy MD/CEO; 5,55,000 preference shares to Birla Management Centre Services
- *What it reveals:* The mature, cash-generative business left: ABLBL FY25 revenue Rs 7,619 Cr, EBITDA Rs 1,269 Cr, PAT Rs 168 Cr, net debt Rs 781 Cr, "expected to become debt free in the next 2-3 years"; residual ABFRL FY25 PAT -Rs 624 Cr
- *Selling pressure:* unclear — Spin is as large as parent (Rs 7,619 Cr vs 7,355 Cr), same apparel industry, 1:1 to all holders; index treatment not stated
- *Parent or spin:* spin · *option pricing date:* not stated
- *Read next:* ABLBL's own FY26 standalone results/net debt of Rs 781 Cr and the 24.32% cost-of-acquisition apportionment
- *In their words:* “The Equity Shares of the Resulting Company listed on BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on June 23, 2025.”

**Stated in the filings:** demerged undertaking: comprising of the Commercial Vehicles Business, from the; entitlement **37 for every 100**; record date 2025-10-14; size hint: 0.91% of net worth.

**What is being separated, as the documents put it:** The Commercial Vehicles Business of Tata Motors Limited, demerged on a going concern basis into TML Commercial Vehicles Limited — class `value_unlocking`.

- *Insiders:* Shareholding pattern of Resulting Company mirrors Demerged Company on Record Date, including common promoters (Tata Sons). Promoter group held 1,565,402,703 of 3,682,582,902 shares. P B Balaji (4,93,186 shares) sits on Tata Motors Limited's board.
- *What it reveals:* Cost-of-acquisition apportionment implies CV 31.15% and PV 68.85% of value. Parent retains Passenger Vehicles, EV business and JLR; India PV business is net cash (~Rs.5,000-7,000 Cr) while JLR carried ~Rs.33,000 Cr net debt. Separate listing enables price discovery and segment-specific investors.
- *Selling pressure:* likely — Every TML holder got 1:1 CV shares; shares untradeable ~45-60 days from allotment (Oct 15) to listing (Nov 12), with price adjusted by exchange discovery.
- *Parent or spin:* both · *option pricing date:* not stated
- *Read next:* Clause 9 of the Composite Scheme on share-based incentives, and Tata Motors Limited (formerly TMLCV) first standalone post-listing results.
- *In their words:* “The Scheme would unlock value for the overall-business portfolio through price-discovery of the Amalgamated Company and the Resulting Company for existing shareholders and shall entail direct holding of marketable securities therein;”

> **Listing:** LISTED — Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited trades since about 2026-05-01 (record date 2026-05-01)

**The stages, as filed:** announced (2026-07-30) → exchange_noc (2024-07-31) → meetings (2025-01-17) → nclt_sanction (2024-11-22) → record_date (2026-05-01)

**Stated in the filings:** resulting company **Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited**; demerged undertaking: s viz. Aluminium Undertaking (as defined under the Scheme), the Merchant Power; record date 2026-05-01; pro-forma statements referenced; size hint: 7% of profit.

**What is being separated, as the documents put it:** Aluminium, Merchant Power, Oil & Gas and Iron Ore undertakings of Vedanta Limited into four separately listed companies — class `value_unlocking`.

- *Insiders:* Promoter Vedanta Resources held 54.72% of VEDL (30 June 2026) via Twin Star 40.02%, Vedanta Holdings Mauritius II 12.60%, Welter 0.98%; 1:1 proportionate shares in each resulting company; promoter shares encumbered under VRL facility agreement
- *What it reveals:* Residual VEDL keeps Zinc India/silver, 0.30x net debt/EBITDA, AA+ rating; aluminium carries $3.5bn of $5.5bn net debt, power 4.7x. Cost apportionment (VEDL 52.34%, Oil&Gas 21.49%, Aluminium 7.15%) differs sharply from EBITDA mix; combined market cap rose ₹71,000 crore in Q1FY27
- *Selling pressure:* likely — Four entities listed simultaneously on 15 June 2026 across unrelated industries; VEDL had "highest weightage among Nifty Next 50 companies", so index holders received unindexed shares
- *Parent or spin:* parent · *option pricing date:* not stated
- *Read next:* First standalone results of Vedanta Power (4.7x pro-forma net debt/EBITDA, Athena boiler incident) and Vedanta Oil & Gas
- *In their words:* “Vedanta's demerger is unlocking significant shareholder value, with combined market cap of resulting companies growing by over ₹71,000 crore in the 1st quarter.”

## RAYMOND — Raymond Ltd.

**CONFIRMED** (a demerger scheme is on the exchange record) · **LISTED 1–2Y — the second-year window** · score 5.8/10 · spin-off · 47 filing(s) from NSE, NSE-register · first 2024-05-03, latest 2026-11-02

> **Listing:** LISTED — Raymond Lifestyle Limited trades since about 2025-05-14 (record date 2025-05-14)

**The stages, as filed:** announced (2024-07-04) → exchange_noc (2024-11-21) → meetings (2025-01-25) → nclt_sanction (2024-06-21) → effective (2025-05-01) → record_date (2025-05-14)

**Stated in the filings:** resulting company **Raymond Lifestyle Limited**; demerged undertaking: carried on by the; entitlement **4 for every 5**; record date 2025-05-14; appointed date 2023-04-01; size hint: 4% of ebitda.

**What is being separated, as the documents put it:** The lifestyle business — branded textiles, branded apparel, garmenting, shirting — into Raymond Lifestyle Limited — class `value_unlocking`.

- *Insiders:* Promoter & Promoter Group hold 48.87% of Raymond Ltd; "PROMOTER STEWARDSHIP 48.87% – 59.62%" across the three listed entities; promoter is largest shareholder and chairs the Board. RLL-specific stake not stated.
- *What it reveals:* Lifestyle is the group's profit engine: 51% of H1FY27 EBITDA (₹404 Cr), rated AA/A1+, net cash positive ₹69 Cr vs ₹(246) Cr a year earlier — while the parent is left as a net-cash engineering/aerospace business.
- *Selling pressure:* unclear — Documents give size, ratings and shareholder counts but say nothing on index exclusion or distribution; RLL is the largest EBITDA contributor, not a small cast-off.
- *Parent or spin:* parent · *option pricing date:* not stated
- *Read next:* Raymond Lifestyle Limited's own standalone/consolidated financials and the demerger scheme — neither is in these filings
- *In their words:* “Raymond Lifestyle Limited represents the bedrock of earnings, delivering 55% of Q2 EBITDA (270) and 51% of YTD EBITDA (404) with steady single-digit expansion (4% in Q2, 6% YTD)”

## Rights and preferential offerings — who is buying

A rights issue hands the paper to existing holders; a preferential issue of equity or warrants hands it to named buyers at a fixed price. The notes' question is the same for both: are the insiders putting money in? Promoters taking warrants (25% upfront, 18 months to convert) is insiders betting on the stock; paper placed with outsiders is dilution. Each row names the buyers the filings name.

Companies whose management used forward-looking spin-off / demerger / listing language in the last 12 months of calls but have no restructuring filing on file.

| Company | What the calls indicate | Forward-looking / all mentions | Latest | Example |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| **KRBL** | spin-off | 2 / 2 | 2025-11 | “…ess will be shifted into that subsidiary company. Hitesh Goel : But sir, subsidiary also the funds will flow from KRBL only, right? I mean can't we do a proper demerger? Anoop Kumar Gupta: Yes, funds” |
| **HDBFS** | spin-off | 1 / 1 | 2026-01 | “…wth. I think we have not even stopped during COVID. So that is one area we wi ll absolutely continue to invest in. Whatever it takes, we will make sure we will carve out for the business to grow. It ” |
| **SBILIFE** | spin-off | 1 / 1 | 2026-07 | “…he ROP. Moderator: We will take the next question from the line of Neeraj Toshniwal from UBS. Neeraj Toshniwal: How has been the growth in credit protect given carve out GTI, if you can have that num” |

## How this was built

- **Filings:** NSE's corporate-announcements feed read month by month for the 2024-04-01 → 2026-11-15 window and filtered to the 752 official NiftyTotalMarket constituents; BSE via its daily RSS (accumulating) and the BSE-sourced per-company lists on screener.in. Each filing is classified by category and headline, its attachment reduced to text and re-classified from the text. Stored in `IndividualStockAnalysis/India/Announcements/NiftyTotalMarket/`.
- **Confidence:** confirmed = a Demerger / Scheme filing or a scheme text that demerges is on the exchange record; probable = a subsidiary listing in motion or a scheme whose nature the documents do not settle; indicated = news verification, denial or calls alone.
- **Listing:** from the record date and listing filings; where neither exists, what the filings and calls say about timing, or that nothing is stated. The 4–10 week note is the typical gap between record date and listing seen in these filings, not a forecast.
- **Rationale:** every passage in the last 36 months of the stored calls where the separation was discussed, plus the scheme's rationale section, read by the judge; each point links to its transcript. Transcripts and presentations are indexed in `InvestorPresentations/NiftyTotalMarket/_concall_links.csv`.
- **Parent numbers:** the stored consolidated P&L and cash-flow statements (screener.in); growth and margins computed here. P/E from the live Nifty 500 market file, else latest stored close ÷ latest fiscal-year EPS. Charts are Mermaid xychart blocks (render on GitHub).
- **Segment numbers:** the last three annual reports and twelve quarterly presentations (`AnnualReports/`, `InvestorPresentations/`, page-marked text), their segment-reporting pages read by the judge with document and page per number; growth and margins computed here. Where the pages do not carry the figures, the report says so.
- **Judge:** claude-opus-5 read the schemes, three years of calls and the segment pages; reads only the documents shown to it, must quote, cached per document hash and model.
- **Score:** share of checklist items answered yes (1) or partly (½), on 10 — visibility of the pattern in the documents, not stock quality.
- **Coverage:** `_coverage.csv` lists, per highlighted company, which of the above was found and which was not.
